status: PROPOSED ONLY. No agent-ee code is changed by AGENTEE-478; consumption is AGENTEE-479 after the Rust landing (AGENTEE-476).

pipeline_as_it_actually_is.stage_A_block_packing: Python: agent_ee.blocks.pack_block (blocks.py:478) produces agent-ee.block-candidate/2. Rust has no stage-A packer (473b).
pipeline_as_it_actually_is.stage_B_arrangement: Rust is the DEFAULT once AGENTEE-476 ships: crates/placement-engine arrangement::plan (lib.rs dispatch, arrangement.rs).
pipeline_as_it_actually_is.candidate_admission: Rust default: blocks.rs validate_candidate (:769) and admit (:1913).
pipeline_as_it_actually_is.residual_pack: Rust default: packing::pack. With the D1 allocation v2 the residual set is empty (fixed and shared parts carry explicit rules, D5); a non-empty residual is a refusal, not a flat fallback.
pipeline_as_it_actually_is.python_reference: Python stage B / admission / residual pack (block_arrangement.py, placer.py) is an EXPLICIT parity reference only (scripts/placement_engine_parity.py). It is never a silent fallback inside a Rust session.
pipeline_as_it_actually_is.saved_board_validation: Python (placer_runner._saved_judgment), planner-independent; the D3/D4 per-block final report belongs here.
pipeline_as_it_actually_is.not_claimed: The pipeline is hybrid. It is not 'all Rust': stage A and saved-board validation stay Python.

fields.blocks[].anchor: one of {member: ref} | {fixed: ref} | {none: 'centroid of members'}
fields.blocks[].interfaces_to_fixed: fixed ref the block is anchored or interfaced to, or null
fields.fixed[]: {reference, register_entries[] (AGENTEE-474 ids)}; pose and rules in fixed-shared-rules.json
fields.corrections[]: audit trail versus /1: {references, from, to, reason, evidence}

agent-ee.block-allocation/2.strict_coverage: consumer refuses unless every captured footprint is in exactly one of blocks[].references, fixed[], shared[] (validate_coverage.py is the stand-alone reference check). No 'residual' key, no root-sheet bucket.
agent-ee.block-allocation/2.consumer: blocks.derive strict mode (Python) and blocks.rs derive (Rust) - parity required; or the stand-alone validator before planning so neither derive changes before AGENTEE-479

fields.blocks.<id>.eligible_faces: subset of [F,B]; anything narrower than the default must carry face_restrictions[] with a 474 id
fields.blocks.<id>.material_unknowns[]: {id, what, region, face}: carried into the final report as UNKNOWN, never as pass
fields.blocks.<id>.same_face_relationships[]: relationship ids that a split across faces would violate
fields.shared: TP1-TP6 common-face rule; JP1-JP5 follow their block

fome-mc.side-eligibility/1.consumer: placement_adapter.binding binds the record (Python); placer_runner._side_changes derives agent-ee.side-changes/1 authorization from it (rebase point with 6f48b9f2); stage A builds one variant per eligible face; stage B searches rotation x eligible face

fields.relationships[].support: {ref, pin_net} (support pad = its pad on device.net)
fields.relationships[].bound: {metric, supply_leg_max_mm, return_leg_max_mm|null, same_face_required} or {status: UNRESOLVED, reason}
fields.relationships[].provenance[]: {class in MFR|TOPOLOGY|ENGINEERING-JUDGEMENT, source, sha256, page, text}
fields.metric: 3D pad-centre distance; dz = 1.6 mm when pads are on opposite faces; return leg = support GND pad to nearest device GND pad

fome-mc.relationship-bounds/1.enforcement: a bound with numeric value is HARD in search and final validation (electrical_locality enforcement 'hard'); UNRESOLVED blocks acceptance of that relationship and is reported, never silently passed
fome-mc.relationship-bounds/1.consumer: electrical_locality.py (Python) and locality.rs (Rust): parity; final saved-board report in Python

fields.split_criterion: deliberate vs lost_cohesion rules; regression contract

fome-mc.cross-face-templates/1.consumer: final per-block report (Python) classifies every opposite-face member; stage A may emit a deliberate cross-face member only through an instance

fome-mc.fixed-shared-rules/1.consumer: fixed_refs + obstacles + groups in the placement policy (both planners already consume these), plus the final report access checks

agent-ee.block-candidate-set/1 (stage-A.status: PROPOSED, PENDING AGREEMENT WITH agent-524 (Rust holder). 449 routes the agreement through 519 before any code touches this boundary.
agent-ee.block-candidate-set/1 (stage-A.design: smallest compatible change: a wrapper around UNCHANGED agent-ee.block-candidate/2 documents, one per eligible face. Rust validate_candidate (blocks.rs:769) keeps its exact key set, so every variant is validated by the existing function; only the wrapper is new.

shape.captured_face: F|B (the face the members are captured on)

variants.F: agent-ee.block-candidate/2 document (byte-identical to today's candidate when F is the captured face)
variants.B: agent-ee.block-candidate/2 document whose members[] rows carry side 'B' and courtyard/pins taken from the NATIVE pcbnew Flip(position, FLIP_DIRECTION_LEFT_RIGHT) of each captured footprint (not a synthetic mirror)

admission_rules: variant faces are a subset of eligibility.eligible_faces; a face not eligible is refused
per member, the variant pad inventory equals the native flip of the captured footprint (same check as the R5 _flipped_inventory declared transform)
same block_id, same member set, same frame anchor in every variant
agent-ee.block-candidate-set/1 (stage-A.producer: Python stage A (blocks.pack_block run once per eligible face on the natively flipped capture)
agent-ee.block-candidate-set/1 (stage-A.consumer: Rust admit (blocks.rs:1913) and stage B (arrangement.rs:743 loop over rotation x variant face); macro side = variant face (arrangement.rs:210 / footprint.rs:413); plan pose gains 'side' (packing.rs:854, arrangement.rs:357)
agent-ee.block-candidate-set/1 (stage-A.backward_compatibility: a plain block-candidate/2 is read as a set with one variant (its captured face)
